trend: Fibre keeps trending in trade press; PHGG is the fibre in SILT Mornings
why: Product post 1 of 2 allowed. Dose honesty: the trial used 6 g, we use 5 g, and we say so.
text:
Why PHGG for the fibre in SILT Mornings? It dissolves thin in water instead of turning to sludge, and it ferments more slowly than inulin in lab tests.

In one IBS trial, 6 g a day improved bloating scores over 12 weeks. A small trial, and our stick has 5 g, a bit under that.
